allow: Bash(python3.12 -c "import engine.nlu; import engine.flow_engine; import engine.escalation; import engine.summary; print\('imports ok'\)")

Bash(python3.12 - << 'EOF'
from engine.escalation import check_escalation
from engine.nlu import RetailIntent, RetailCategory

r = check_escalation\(RetailIntent.REQUEST_AGENT, None, 0, 0, []\)
assert r.should_escalate == True and r.priority == "immediate"

r = check_escalation\(RetailIntent.PAYMENT_QUERY, None, 0, 0, []\)
assert r.should_escalate == True

r = check_escalation\(RetailIntent.QUALITY_ISSUE, RetailCategory.ELECTRONICS, 0, 0, []\)
assert r.should_escalate == True

r = check_escalation\(RetailIntent.UNKNOWN, None, 0, 3, []\)
assert r.should_escalate == True

r = check_escalation\(RetailIntent.QUALITY_ISSUE, RetailCategory.FB, 0, 0, []\)
assert r.should_escalate == False

r = check_escalation\(RetailIntent.QUALITY_ISSUE, RetailCategory.FB, 2, 0, []\)
assert r.should_escalate == True

print\("Escalation tests passed"\)
EOF)
